verdict.rationale: Whether the source is published under an open license is a fair question for any software product, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows that users can view and edit the code Make generates for their own apps. That is adjacent, not the product's own source, and nothing indicates Figma Make itself is released under an open license. Community reports of reverse-engineering an undocumented .make binary point to a closed product, not an open one.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
